Select drug ChEMBL ID, preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, EFO ID as indication_curie, EFO term as indication_label, and max phase for indication. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter for max phase 4 drugs and indications with max phase for ind equal to 3. Return all rows. Sort by drug ChEMBL ID, preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, indication_curie, indication_label, and max phase for ind.
